description: Renovate covers mise.toml's tool pins, which Dependabot has no ecosystem for, and the gitleaks version pinned in .github/workflows/gitleaks.yml; SwiftPM and Actions stay with .github/dependabot.yml.

customManagers.description: GITLEAKS_VERSION in gitleaks.yml. Renovate cannot rewrite GITLEAKS_SHA256, so the bump PR's gitleaks run (pull_request trigger) fails the checksum step until a human updates it (fail-closed).

prBodyNotes: GITLEAKS_SHA256 in .github/workflows/gitleaks.yml is not updated by Renovate, so this PR's Gitleaks History Scan run fails its sha256sum check until it is. Copy the linux_x64 line's hash from this release's gitleaks_<version>_checksums.txt into GITLEAKS_SHA256, push, and merge only once that run passes.
